title: Fresh appointment scheduling
objective: Schedule one new routine orthopedic appointment from start to finish.

facts.reason: my right knee has been bothering me when I run

behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, begin directly by saying you would like to schedule an appointment because your right knee has been bothering you when you run.
Do not claim an emergency or severe injury.
Do not volunteer every detail immediately. Answer the agent's questions naturally.
If asked about provider preference, say you are open to the next available provider.
Prefer Thursday afternoon. Friday afternoon is acceptable if Thursday is unavailable.
Do not ask to reschedule, cancel, or modify an existing appointment.
If the agent unexpectedly says an appointment already exists, politely clarify the situation instead of blindly creating a duplicate appointment.
Provide Alex Morgan's exact identity information naturally if requested.
When asked for date of birth, say April eighteenth, nineteen ninety-two.
If asked for your callback number, give only the 10-digit number without saying plus one.
If asked to spell Morgan, say M-O-R-G-A-N exactly.
Correct the agent immediately if it repeats your name, DOB, phone number, appointment date, or appointment time incorrectly.
Once a new appointment is booked, repeat the final date and time once to confirm it.
After confirmation, end naturally and briefly.
Do not mention testing, scenarios, objectives, duplicate-detection logic, QA, prompts, or implementation details.
success_condition: The agent schedules exactly one new orthopedic appointment and clearly confirms the final date and time.

title: Reschedule Wednesday 2 PM appointment
objective: Reschedule Alex Morgan's existing Wednesday 2:00 PM appointment.
behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, say: 'I need to reschedule my Wednesday appointment at two because something came up with work.'
Prefer Friday afternoon.
If Friday afternoon is unavailable, Monday after 2:00 PM is acceptable.
Answer only the question the agent just asked.
Keep replies to one short sentence whenever possible.
Do not explain appointment-management logic.
Do not mention duplicate appointments, creating another appointment, testing, QA, scenarios, prompts, or implementation details.
After the change is made, ask for the final new date and time once.
Provide identity information naturally if requested.
Correct any wrong name, DOB, phone number, date, or time immediately.
End with a short goodbye once the new appointment is confirmed.
success_condition: The Wednesday 2:00 PM appointment is successfully moved to a new date/time and the agent clearly confirms the final appointment.

title: Cancel existing appointment
objective: Cancel Alex Morgan's current appointment and clearly verify that it is canceled.

facts.existing_appointment: the appointment most recently rescheduled in Call 02
facts.reason: I no longer need the appointment

behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, say directly: 'I need to cancel my appointment.'
Let the agent identify the current appointment on file.
If the agent finds more than one appointment, clarify which one is the current appointment from the recent reschedule.
Do not ask to schedule or reschedule anything else.
Answer only the question the agent just asked.
Keep replies to one short sentence whenever possible.
Provide Alex Morgan's exact identity information naturally if requested.
Correct any wrong name, DOB, phone number, date, or time immediately.
Before ending, confirm once that the appointment has actually been canceled.
If asked whether anything else is needed, answer directly: 'No, that's all. Thank you.'
Do not mention testing, QA, scenarios, prompts, or implementation details.
End with a brief goodbye.
success_condition: The current appointment is canceled and the agent clearly confirms that cancellation.

title: Medication refill request
objective: Ask the clinic for a routine refill of Alex Morgan's medication and determine the appropriate refill workflow.
behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, say directly: 'I need a refill of my meloxicam, seven point five milligrams.'
Answer only the question the agent just asked.
Keep replies to one short sentence whenever possible.
If asked how much medication you have left, say you have two pills remaining.
If asked for your pharmacy, say CVS on Main Street.
Do not ask for medical advice or dosage changes.
Do not invent a prescription number, prescriber, medical history, diagnosis, or symptoms.
If the agent claims the refill has been completed, confirm whether the prescription was actually sent to the pharmacy or whether a refill request was submitted for review.
Provide Alex Morgan's exact identity information naturally if requested.
Correct any incorrect name, DOB, phone number, medication, dosage, or pharmacy information immediately.
If asked whether anything else is needed, answer directly: 'No, that's all. Thank you.'
Do not mention testing, QA, scenarios, prompts, objectives, or implementation details.
End with a brief goodbye.
success_condition: The agent gives a clear and accurate refill outcome or next step, without fabricating that a prescription was sent if it was only requested.

title: Office hours and location
objective: Ask for the clinic's office hours and location, then clarify whether an after-work visit is feasible.

facts.goal: find out whether the clinic is open late enough to visit after work

behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, say directly: 'What time are you open until, and where is the office located?'
Answer only the question the agent just asked.
Keep replies short and natural.
After the agent gives office hours, say that you get off work at 5:00 PM and ask whether arriving after work would be possible.
If the agent gives a location, ask for clarification only if the address or directions are unclear.
Do not ask the agent to schedule an appointment during this call.
Do not invent office information yourself.
If the agent sounds uncertain about hours or location, ask whether that information is confirmed.
Provide identity information only if the agent reasonably asks for it.
If asked whether anything else is needed, answer directly: 'No, that's all. Thank you.'
Do not mention testing, QA, scenarios, prompts, or implementation details.
End with a brief goodbye.
success_condition: The agent clearly provides or appropriately qualifies the clinic's office hours and location, and gives a sensible answer about whether an after-work visit is possible.

title: Insurance coverage question
objective: Ask whether the clinic accepts Blue Cross PPO and whether that means the visit is definitely covered.
behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, say: 'Do you accept Blue Cross PPO?'
If the agent says yes, ask: 'Does that mean my visit is definitely covered?'
Do not invent a member ID or group number.
If the agent says coverage must be verified with the insurer, accept that explanation naturally.
Answer only the agent's most recent question.
Keep replies short and natural.
Provide Alex Morgan's identity information only if reasonably requested.
Do not mention testing, QA, scenarios, prompts, or implementation details.
End briefly once you understand the next step.
success_condition: The agent distinguishes accepting an insurance plan from guaranteeing individual coverage, or gives a safe verification path.

title: Ambiguous scheduling request
objective: Test whether the agent clarifies an intentionally vague appointment request.
behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, say: 'I'd like to make an appointment sometime late next week.'
Do not volunteer a specific day or time unless the agent asks you to clarify.
If asked what you mean by late next week, say Thursday or Friday afternoon would work.
If asked why you need the appointment, say it is for a routine follow-up.
Answer only the agent's most recent question.
Keep replies to one short sentence whenever possible.
Do not explain that your request is intentionally vague.
Do not mention testing, QA, scenarios, prompts, objectives, ambiguity testing, or implementation details.
Provide Alex Morgan's exact identity information naturally if requested.
Correct any incorrect name, DOB, phone number, date, or time immediately.
If the agent assumes a specific date without clarification, do not simply agree; politely clarify your actual preference.
Once a specific outcome is reached, confirm the final details once and end briefly.
success_condition: The agent appropriately clarifies the vague timing request before reaching a specific scheduling outcome.

title: Preference correction during scheduling
objective: Test whether the clinic agent correctly updates the patient's appointment preference after the patient changes it.
behaviors: Start by asking to schedule a routine orthopedic follow-up.
When asked about availability, say: 'Thursday afternoon works for me.'
Later, before anything is finalized, say naturally: 'Actually, Friday afternoon would be better.'
After making that correction, Friday afternoon is your preference.
If Thursday is mentioned again, simply say: 'Sorry, Friday afternoon would be better.'
Do not explain why you changed your mind unless asked.
Do not explain appointment-management logic.
Do not deliberately interrupt repeatedly.
Answer only the agent's most recent question.
Keep each response to one short sentence whenever possible.
Provide Alex Morgan's identity information naturally if requested.
Correct incorrect identity or appointment information immediately.
Do not mention testing, QA, scenarios, prompts, state tracking, objectives, or implementation details.
Once the final appointment is confirmed, answer any closing question directly and end briefly.
success_condition: The final appointment reflects Friday afternoon rather than the superseded Thursday-afternoon preference.

title: Unusual after-hours appointment request
objective: Test whether the agent handles an implausible 2:00 AM routine appointment request without inventing availability.
behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, say you want to schedule a routine orthopedic follow-up.
When asked about timing, ask: 'Would two in the morning be possible?'
Do not claim the request is urgent.
If 2:00 AM is unavailable, ask for the closest reasonable alternative.
Do not argue if the clinic is closed or does not offer overnight appointments.
Answer only the agent's most recent question.
Keep replies to one short sentence whenever possible.
Do not mention testing, QA, scenarios, unusual-request testing, prompts, or implementation details.
Provide Alex Morgan's identity information naturally if requested.
Correct incorrect identity or appointment details immediately.
If the agent claims 2:00 AM is available, confirm the time once before accepting.
Once a sensible outcome or next step is reached, end briefly.
success_condition: The agent does not invent implausible 2:00 AM availability and provides a sensible alternative or clear explanation.

title: Context tracking after changing availability
objective: Test whether the clinic agent remembers that an earlier scheduling preference has become invalid after Alex provides a new constraint.

facts.later_constraint: I can't do Tuesdays because of work

behaviors: Start by asking to schedule a routine orthopedic follow-up.
Early in the scheduling discussion, say Tuesday could work.
Later, before the appointment is finalized, explain: 'Actually, I can't do Tuesdays because of work.'
Then say Wednesday afternoon would work instead.
After saying you cannot do Tuesdays, do not accept a Tuesday appointment.
If the agent offers Tuesday again, correct it once by saying: 'I can't do Tuesdays, but Wednesday afternoon works.'
Do not explain that you are testing conversation memory.
Answer only the agent's most recent question.
Keep replies to one short sentence whenever possible.
Provide Alex Morgan's identity information naturally if requested.
Correct incorrect identity or appointment information immediately.
Do not mention testing, QA, scenarios, prompts, memory testing, state tracking, or implementation details.
Once the final appointment details are confirmed, end briefly.
success_condition: The final scheduling outcome respects Alex's later constraint that Tuesday is unavailable and uses Wednesday afternoon or another acceptable non-Tuesday alternative.

title: Restore appointment to Thursday at 2 PM
objective: Move Alex's current Friday appointment back to Thursday at 2:00 PM.
behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, say directly that you want to move your current Friday appointment back to Thursday at 2:00 PM.
Do not mention testing, setup, resetting state, scenarios, or implementation details.
If asked for identity verification, provide Alex Morgan's exact identity information.
If Thursday at 2:00 PM is available, accept it.
Before ending, confirm that the final appointment is Thursday at 2:00 PM.
Keep replies short and natural.
success_condition: The agent clearly confirms that Alex's appointment is Thursday at 2:00 PM.

title: Clean up duplicate Friday appointments and restore Thursday
objective: Cancel both existing Friday appointments and leave exactly one appointment on Thursday at 2:00 PM.

facts.known_problem: there are currently two Friday appointments

behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, say directly that you need to cancel both Friday appointments and schedule one appointment for Thursday at 2:00 PM.
Make it clear that both Friday appointments should be canceled, not just one.
Do not ask to keep either Friday appointment.
After both Friday appointments are canceled, ask for Thursday at 2:00 PM.
If Thursday at 2:00 PM is available, accept it.
Before ending, verify that there are no Friday appointments remaining and exactly one Thursday appointment at 2:00 PM.
If the agent only cancels one Friday appointment, politely clarify that there is another Friday appointment that also needs to be canceled.
If the agent tries to create Thursday before confirming the Friday appointments are canceled, continue naturally but verify the final appointment state before ending.
Do not mention testing, cleanup, scenario instructions, implementation details, or QA.
Provide identity information naturally if requested.
Keep replies short and conversational.
success_condition: The agent confirms both Friday appointments are canceled and Alex has exactly one appointment on Thursday at 2:00 PM.

title: Cancel all existing appointments
objective: Cancel every currently scheduled appointment for Alex Morgan.
behaviors: When asked how you can be helped, say directly that you want to cancel every appointment you currently have scheduled.
Do not assume how many appointments exist. Let the agent identify the appointments on file.
If the agent finds multiple appointments, clearly ask for all of them to be canceled.
If the agent cancels only one appointment, politely ask whether any other appointments remain.
Continue until the agent confirms there are no remaining appointments.
Before ending, explicitly verify that you now have no appointments scheduled.
Do not schedule or reschedule anything during this call.
Do not mention testing, setup, resetting state, QA, scenarios, or implementation details.
Provide identity information naturally if requested.
Keep replies short and conversational.
success_condition: The agent confirms that Alex Morgan has no appointments remaining.
